root_cause.text: The `trace_event_reg` function in the tracing subsystem fails to validate whether the `perf_probe` callback of a trace event class is non-NULL before passing it to `tracepoint_probe_register` during `TRACE_REG_PERF_REGISTER` registration, resulting in a kernel warning when attempting to register unsupported perf events (such as synthetic events).
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds a check `if (!call->class->perf_probe) return -ENODEV;` under the `TRACE_REG_PERF_REGISTER` case in `kernel/trace/trace_events.c` to prevent passing a NULL pointer to `tracepoint_probe_register`.
